inherited_release_gate.note: All prior console extraction/rendering/audio/route/camera and dev15-dev17 mobile-format/exclusives behavior gates are inherited. dev18 adds iOS-to-console executable-lineage research without modifying sealed dev17.

fresh_package.note: Final package is rebuilt deterministically after recording these candidate results and is revalidated separately before publication.

limitations: Exact Xbox address of the authored DAT loader is not yet isolated from retained console references.
Exact console generator-map output-buffer initializer corresponding to iOS stageGenerateMapInit is not yet isolated.
The exact cause of the console generator resource corpus's 2x total cell capacity remains unresolved.
Normal-stage content is substantially retuned even where opcode sequence structure is preserved; code lineage must not be described as byte-identical stage content.
The iOS executable is from the supplied decrypted/modified-distribution 4.1.0 research IPA; executable/resource lineage findings do not imply wrapper authenticity.
Individual low-range enemy-handler instruction-level correspondences are not yet exhaustively mapped across iOS and console.
Existing console limitations on shader ISA translation, real Blender UI/runtime validation, and project-owner license selection remain.
